highlights.reason_zh: OpenShell 已能试验外置策略边界，Sentry 则明确保留了尚未开放的硬件隔离限制。
highlights.reason_en: OpenShell makes external policy boundaries testable now, while Sentry is clearly bounded as unavailable hardware isolation.

highlights.reason_zh: Google Cloud 采购与治理入口可能改变模型选型，但 GA 和完整服务条件仍待公布。
highlights.reason_en: Google Cloud procurement and governance may change model selection, while GA and complete service terms remain pending.

highlights.reason_zh: Package Firewall 把 npm 依赖策略移到组织级代理，直接影响 agent 与 CI 的供应链边界。
highlights.reason_en: Package Firewall moves npm dependency policy into an organization proxy, directly changing supply-chain boundaries for agents and CI.

highlights.reason_zh: RFD4-Proteina 公开代码、权重与测试数据，让蛋白质联合设计方法可以立即复现。
highlights.reason_en: RFD4-Proteina publishes code, weights and test data, making its protein co-design method immediately reproducible.

highlights.reason_zh: FairStress 可发现最终答案一致时仍隐藏的判断标准不稳定，适合上线前压力测试。
highlights.reason_en: FairStress exposes unstable decision criteria even when final answers match, making it useful for predeployment stress tests.

coverage_zh: 36/36 个固定入口抓取并读完；主动检索覆盖小团队、开放权重、非英语材料、agent 安全、研究、基础设施、政策与重大综合新闻。发布方效果均标明待独立验证；Sentry 与 Google Cloud 集成尚未 GA；PHP 漏洞因缺少维护者公告或 CVE 暂缓。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and reviewed; active discovery covered small teams, open weights, non-English material, agent security, research, infrastructure, policy and major general news. Publisher results remain marked for independent validation; Sentry and the Google Cloud integration are not GA; the PHP disclosure is deferred pending a maintainer advisory or CVEs.
